name: PT Aman Agrindo Tbk
summary: Headquartered in Semarang, Indonesia, PT Aman Agrindo Tbk began its operations in 2013. The company's core business in Indonesia revolves around sugarcane cultivation and sugar trading, offering granulated, liquid, and brown sugar products. Diversifying its activities, it also participates in the wholesale and retail of a broad spectrum of goods, including food, various beverages, tobacco, agricultural products, livestock, beverage ingredients, and food commodities. Additionally, the company is involved in the farming of vegetables, fruits, and tubers.
